name: North Ridge
approach: From Ballpark Campground at Holden Village (~3,300 ft), take Railroad Creek Trail (#1240) about 1 mile to its junction with Holden Lake Trail (#1251); turn right/south and hike roughly 4 miles to Holden Lake (5,278 ft). Continue past the lake toward Holden Pass (6,360 ft), where most parties establish high camp, or continue on a climbers' path through slide alder toward the base of the Mary Green Glacier (~7,300 ft).
